sentences.en: They were kissing, their bodies pressed together and arms around each other.

sentences.en: For a few minutes they held on to each other, kissing as if they hadn't seen each other in a week.

sentences.en: Martha shouted, throwing her arms around my neck and kissing me on the lips while I still clung on to my steering wheel.
